f.desc: You perform a ritual of Absolution over a corpse, or number of corpses equal to your spellcasting ability Modifier, forgiving them for the sins they committed in life, for the next 2 months the corpse(s) cannot be affected by spells like the Animated dead, Raise Dead, or Resurrection.

tiers: Lay to Rest
Whenever you cast this spell and target the corpse of an Undead creature such as a Zombie, Skeleton, or a Ghoul, their Corpses dissolve into Ash and they become Invalid Targets for Reanimation.

f.desc:
You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a Stream of acidic wash from your palm. The creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d12 Acid damage and if your target is wearing metallic armor their AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn, if the target is a Construct their AC is instead Reduced by 3. On Successful save the targets AC is not reduced and the target only takes half damage.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 1st.

tiers: Splash Damage
whenever you deal damage you deal an extra 1d4 acid damage
Test
Test

f.desc: When you are targeted by a spell cast by a hostile creature, you can cast this spell to create a protective barrier of arcane energy around you. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +3 bonus to AC against spell attacks and a +3 bonus to Dexterity saving throws against spells. At the start of your next turn, you gain 1 Exhaustion Point (EP).

tiers: Convergence
Casting this spell no longer consumes its material cost.
Wide Barrier

Whenever you cast this spell, you may choose to gain 1 addition Exhaustion Point (EP), if you do, choose two target allies within 5ft of you. Both allies gain a +3 bonus to AC against spell attacks and a +3 bonus to Dexterity saving throws against spells until next turn.
Shared Ward

You can also cast this spell when a creature you can see within 30 feet is targeted by a spell or is within the target area of a spell. The barrier protects them instead of you, but you still gain the Exhaustion Points from casting it.
Whenever you cast this spell, you instead gain a+4 bonus to AC vs Spell attacks.
Whenever you cast this spell, you instead gain a+5 bonus to AC vs Spell attacks.
Absorption
When you cast this spell, If a spell attack misses you, or you succeed on a saving throw against a spell targeting you, you gain MP equal to half that spell’s casting cost.

f.desc: When you are targeted by a weapon attack from a hostile creature, you can cast this spell to raise a shimmering shield of arcane force around you. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +3 bonus to AC against weapon attacks, including the triggering attack, as long as you maintain concentration. At the start of your next turn, you gain 1 Exhaustion Point (EP).

tiers: The shield also protects against unarmed strikes and natural weapons, such as claws and bites.
Recoil
While Arcane Shield is active, whenever a weapon attack misses you, the attacker takes 1d4 Force damage as the shield jolts back at them.
Shared Shield
You can also cast this spell when a creature you can see within 30 feet is targeted by a weapon attack. The shield protects them instead of you, but you still gain the EP from casting it.
The shield’s bonus increases to +4.
The shield’s bonus increases to +5.
Rebuke
Recoil’s damage increases to 1d6 Force, and the attacker is pushed 5 feet away from you.

f.desc:
You crush a wax effigy in your fist and speak a curse on upon one target creature you can see within range. Each target of this spell must make a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, the creature is Cursed for 1 minute. Whenever a Cursed creature makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it subtracts 1d4 from the roll.
A Cursed creature can spend 1 AP on its turn to repeat the saving throw, ending the curse on a success.

tiers: Convergence
Casting this spell no longer consumes its material cost.
Shared Pain
Whenever you cast this spell you may target up to two creatures.
Ill Fortuned
Whenever a cursed target rolls an Action Die, they reduce the roll by 1 (Minimum of 1).
Writhing
For as long as a target remains cursed by this spell, Whenever a Cursed creature rolls the curse's penalty die, it also takes Psychic damage equal to the number rolled.
Shared Fate
Whenever you cast this spell you may target up to three creatures.
Shared Suffering
Whenever you deal damage with another spell to a creature cursed by this spell, each other creature that is cursed takes half the damage of the original target.

f.desc:
You slam your palm to the ground, and a line of thorned vines bursts from the earth in a 15-foot line, 5 feet wide, starting from you. Each creature in the Target Area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, a creature takes 1d6 Piercing damage and is Grappled by the vines. A Grappled creature’s speed is 0. On a success, it takes no damage and isn’t Grappled.

A Grappled creature can spend 1 AP on its turn to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, freeing itself on a success. The vines wither after 1 minute, whenever you cast this spell again, and whenever no creatures remain in its target area.

tiers: This Spell's damage increases to 1d8 Piercing damage.
Thornbed
The Target Area of this spell becomes difficult terrain until the vines wither.
This Spell's damage increases to 1d10 Piercing damage.
The Target area of this spell becomes a 30-foot line, 5 feet wide.
Snatch
On your turn, you can spend 1 AP to drag one creature Grappled by this spell up to 15 feet along the line.
The Target area of this spell becomes a 45-foot line, 10 feet wide.
Overgrown
This Spell's damage increases to 3d10 Piercing damage.
The Target area of this spell becomes a 60-foot line, 10 feet wide.
Stranglehold
Small and Medium sized creatures that are grappled by this spell are also Restrained.

f.desc: You catch a humanoid’s eye and speak a few warm, honeyed words laced with magic. The target must be a humanoid that can see and hear you, and it must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. It has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failure, it is Charmed by you for 1 hour, or until you or your allies do anything harmful to it, and it treats you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed and by whom. When you cast this spell, you gain 1 Exhaustion Point (EP).

tiers: This spell’s range increases to 30 feet.
Convergence
Casting this spell no longer consumes its material cost.
Second Glance
You can target a second humanoid within 10 feet of the first. Each makes its own saving throw.
Subtle Charm

When the spell ends, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC as it shakes off its charmed stupor. On a failure, it doesn’t realize it was charmed. On a success, it knows it was charmed and by whom.
The duration increases to 8 hours
Captivate
The target no longer has Advantage on its save when you or your allies are fighting it.
You can target a third humanoid within 10 feet of the others.
Lingering Haze
When the spell ends, the creature is left reeling as it shakes off the charm. It takes 2d6 Psychic damage and becomes Dazed for its next 1d4 turns in combat.

f.desc: You conjure a concentration of magical light in your palm and force it through a prism splitting it into a roaring wave of color that fans out in a 20-foot cone from you. Choose two color from the Spectrum table. Each creature in the Target Area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 1d8 damage of that color’s type on a failure, or half as much on a success. When you finish casting this spell you gain 1 Exhaustion Point (EP).

cells: if a creature in the spells target area fails the saving throw they become Enflamed.
if a humanoid wearing Metallic armor in the spells target area fails the saving throw, there are rusts and their AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn.
if a creature in the spells target area fails the saving throw they become Dazed until the start if their next turn.
if a creature in the spells target area fails the saving throw they become Sickened.
if a creature in the spells target area fails the saving throw they're movement Speed is reduced by 5ft until the start of your next turn.
if a small or medium sized creature in the spells target area fails the saving throw, they are pushed 5ft back in a straight line.

f.desc: You crush a scrap of burnt paper in your fist, and it reforms as a glowing ball of packed cinders, which you send flying at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Fire damage. Hit or miss, the ball then bursts in a shower of burning ash: the target and each other creature within 5 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or take 1d4 Fire damage.
f.type: Ranged Spell Attack (Attack Roll and Dexterity Save)

tiers: The hit damage increases to 1d10 Fire.
Kindling
The burst ignites flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried, such as dry brush, cloth, oil and wooden crates.
This spell’s range increases to 60 feet.
Smolder
On a hit, the target becomes Enflamed.
The burst’s radius increases to 10 feet.
Smokescreen

The burst leaves a dense cloud of smoke covering a 10ft circle centered on the original target, the smoke last until the start of the next round of combat, while a creature remains in the smoke cloud it is blinded.
This spell’s range increases to 90 feet.
Volley
When you cast this spell, you can spend 2 additional MP to hurl an additional ball of cinders at a different target within range.

f.mat: 250G worth of magical Incense that is consumed upon performing the ritual
f.range: 5ft (Touch) a Magical Item or Object that weighs less than 10lb.
f.desc:
For an hour you can perform an arcane ritual on a Magical Item or Object that weighs less than 10lbs and hide it’s magical nature from those who are able to use magic detection spells such as Detect magic. Upon completion of the ritual, the Item becomes Undetectable by magical detection spells for the Next month. Casting this spell on the same item every once a month for a year makes the Magical Item or Object Permanently Undetectable by magic detection spells until the dispel magic spell is cast on it.

If a spellcaster, other than the item's original Spellcaster, attempts to identify the item, whilst the item is under the effects of this spell, they must roll a d100 and roll above 50 + Original Spellcaster level. Failure to roll high enough results in the Spellcaster being unable to sense any magical presence from the item. On a success, the Item is successfully Identified.

You lay a hand on a creature’s wounds, and warm light knits torn flesh back together. The creature regains hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs. When you cast this spell, you gain 1 Exhaustion Point (EP).

tiers: Purge
The spell also ends the Sickened condition on the creature.
The healing increases to 1d10 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
Knitted Wounds
whenever you cast this spell targeting a creature that has the Bleeding Condition, that creature cannot be inflicted with the bleeding condition for the next 1d4 turns of combat.
Second Wind
When you cast this spell on a unconscious target, it also gains 1 Action Point (AP).
Shared Mending
When you cast this spell, you may choose a secondary target creature with 5ft of you and the original target, the secondary target regains hit-points equal to your Spellcasting Ability Modifier.
Lifeline
whenever you cast this spell targeting a creature that has 0 hit points, it regains a number of hit-points equal to twice your Spellcasting Ability Modifier.

f.desc:
You seize the air and compress it as you whip up the air around you creating an invisible blade of wind. Make a ranged spell attack against a single target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 slashing damage and the target and two other creatures Adjacent within 5 feet of the target must roll Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the slashing damage created by blade of wind increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

You create a 20-foot-cube of Black vaporous fog centered on a point you choose within range. The fog spreads around corners. It lasts for the Duration, ending the spell. Its area is heavily obscured. When a creature enters the spell’s area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a Success the creature takes 10d10 necrotic damage. On a failure the creature drops to 0-hit points and is knocked Unconscious and must start making death saves at the beginning of their next turn. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don’t need to breathe. The fog is static and cannot be moved from the space it was created but does coast alongside the surfaces of the ground and walls. The vapors, being heavier than air, sink to the lowest level of the land, even pouring down openings.

For the duration, you gain the ability to sense the presence of magic within 20 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any.

The spell can penetrate most barriers, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

You make yourself – including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person – look different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear thin, fat, or in between. You can’t change your body type, so you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing or would feel your head and hair. If you use this spell to appear thinner than you are, the hand of someone who reaches out to touch you would bump into you while it was seemingly still in midair. To discern that you are disguised, a creature can use its action to inspect your appearance and must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

f.mat: A Monocle or small glass lens
f.desc:
Choose a 20ft by 20ft cube within range that you can see. Any spell from the Illusion school of 3rd level or lower within that area ends. For each Illusion of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you automatically end the effects of a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used.

You touch the ground and speak an incantation that creates a 10ft by 5ft wall that has a height of 5ft, and thickness of 3ft and lasts for the spell's duration. While you or an ally are using the wall as cover you have ¾ Cover. The Wall itself has an AC of 15 and has 20 hit-points, the wall crumbles if it’s hit-points are reduced to 0, you lose concentration on the spell, drop your concentration on the spells, or the spell's duration ends.

You hold out your fingers and select a point within range, a spike made of stone erupts from the chosen point. Each creature with 5ft of the erupting spike must make Dexterity Saving throw or take 2d10 Bludgeoning damage, half as much on a successful save. If there is a target directly above the erupting spike, and they fail the Save, they are launched 10ft up in the air taking Falling damage and falling prone upon meeting the ground. If there's a Ceiling above the Launched target, they instead take falling damage for the maximum height of the current room. Immediately after casting the spell and creating the spike, the spike immediately retreats back into the ground.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the bludgeoning damage dealt by the earth spike increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

f.mat: 10 gp worth of charcoal, incense, and herbs that must be consumed by fire in a brass brazier
f.desc:
You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: Bat, Bird, Cat, Crab, Dog, Frog (Toad), Hawk, Lizard, Octopus, Owl, Snake, Fish, Rat, Raven, Spider, or Weasel. Appearing in an unoccupied space within range, the familiar has the statistics of the chosen form, though it is a celestial, fey, or fiend (your choice) instead of a beast.

Your familiar acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands. In combat, your familiar takes their turn immediately after yours. A familiar can’t attack, but it can take other actions as normal.

When the familiar drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form. It reappears after you cast this spell again. As an action, you can temporarily dismiss your familiar to a pocket dimension. Alternatively, you can dismiss it forever. As an action while it is temporarily dismissed, you can cause it to reappear in any unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. Whenever the familiar drops to 0 hit points or disappears into the pocket dimension, it leaves behind in its space anything it was wearing or carrying.

While your familiar is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it telepathically. Additionally, as an action, you can see through your familiar’s eyes and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn, gaining the benefits of any special senses that the familiar has. During this time, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses.

You can’t have more than one familiar at a time. If you cast this spell while you already have a familiar, you instead cause it to adopt a new form. Choose one of the forms from the above list. Your familiar transforms into the chosen creature.

You clap a pinch of flammable powder between your hands and sweep your fingers toward a target, speaking the spell’s command phrase. The powder ignites into a bolt of fire that hurls instantly toward your target.
f.dmg: On hit, target takes 1d6 fire damage.

tiers: You can cast this spell using any flamible component rather than using Sulfuric Powder or Coal Dust.
This Spell’s range increases to 45ft.
This spell’s deals 1d8 fire damage instead of 1d6 fire damage.
Kindling
The bolt ignites flammable objects it hits that aren’t being worn or carried, such as torches, kindling, or oil.
You no longer need a material component to cast this spell.
This spell’s deals 1d10 fire damage instead of 1d8 fire damage.
This Spell’s range increases to 60 ft.
On a critical hit, the target becomes Enflamed.
Arcing Bolt
The bolt no longer travels in a straight line and can curve and arc around obstacles to reach a target you can see.
Explosive Bolt
On a Hit, the bolt detonates, each creature within 5ft of the original target must roll a Dexterity Saving throw or take fire damage equal to half the damage dealt to the original target

f.desc:
With both hands you conjure a warbling sheet of fire. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried.
f.dmg: On a failed save, creatures in target area takes 3d6 fire damage, half as much damage on a successful one.

f.desc: You extend a hand and touch of a target within 5ft sending a necrotic shiver up your targets spine. Make a melee spell attack towards the target within 5ft of you, On a Hit the target takes 1d8 Necrotic damage.

You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

You extend a hand project fourth a blasting gust of wind towards target within the spells range. Make a range spell attack, on a hit the target takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and if the target is medium sized or smaller, they must roll a Strength Saving throw or be pushed backwards 5ft. if the target is small or even tiny sized, they have disadvantage on the Strength save.

If the target of the spell is an object of Small or Tiny size, it automatically failed the save and takes no damage.

f.mat: A Blade or Sword you are proficient with (not consumed)
f.desc: You run your hand along your Blade or Sword and speak a single sharp note. The weapon begins to vibrate, letting out a thin, high-pitched hum that sets nearby teeth on edge. While you maintain concentration, the next time you hit a creature with that weapon, the stored vibration releases on impact in a crack of sound: the target takes an extra 1d8 Thunder damage, and each other hostile creature within 5 feet of it must make a Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 Thunder damage. The weapon then falls silent and the spell ends.

tiers: Ringing Parry

While Humming Blade is active and you’re wielding the humming weapon, whenever a creature misses you with a melee weapon attack, it takes 2 Thunder damage as its weapon rings off the vibrating blade. This doesn’t end the spell.
Deafening Ring
Whenever you deal thunder damage with a humming weapon to a creature, those creatures become Deafened until the end of its next turn.
The extra damage increases to 2d8 Thunder.
Supercharge

While Humming Blade is active, if you take Lightning damage, the vibrating blade drinks in the current. Your next melee weapon attack with the humming weapon deals an extra 1d8 Lightning damage on a hit. If that attack misses, the current arcs back through you, and you take the 1d8 Lightning damage instead.
Sonic Slash

When you make the next melee weapon attack with the humming weapon, you can swing it to release its stored vibration as a slash of sound, attacking a creature up to 15 feet away from you as long as their are no obstacles in your way. This counts as a melee weapon attack. On a hit, the spell’s effects resolve as normal.

f.desc: You swipe the air, gather moisture and project forth a arrow-like barrage of icy needles towards a target within range that you can see. Make a Spell attack roll towards a target, on a hit, the target takes 2d4 cold damage.

f.mat: A pearl worth at least 100 gp
f.desc: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement to use, and how many charges it has, if any. You learn whether any spells are affecting the item and what they are. If the item was created by a spell, you learn which spell created it. If you instead touch a creature throughout the casting, you learn what spells, if any, are currently affecting it.

You extend a hand and create a hovering globule of light that you can control, you can manipulate the globule of light and can use a bonus action on your turn to reposition the globule of light anywhere within the spells range. Alternatively, you can set the Globule of light to occupy the same space as you and follow your current position. The Globule of light provides a 10ft-radius of light. At will, you can manipulate if the light is Dim or Bright.

You send forth a crackling bolt of lightning at one creature in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 lightning damage. If you roll the same number on at least two of the d6s, The Lightning jumps and leaps from the target to a different creature of your choice within 30 feet of it. Make a new attack roll against the new target and a new damage roll, which could cause the Lightning to jump again. A creature can be only be targeted once each round by this spell. The Lightning can only leap up to a total of 3 targets in a single cast.

tiers: This spell can leap up to a total of 4 targets in a single cast.
This spell can leap up to a total of 5 targets in a single cast.
Coursing Current
Whenever you hit a target with this spell and the spell leaps to a new target, On a hit, the deals an additional d6 of lighting damage.
Living Lightning
Whenever this spell leaps to a new target, you may target a creature that has already been targeted once by this spell.

f.range: 5ft (Touch) A wooden, metal or stone wall or surface
f.desc: As an action on your turn you can Touch a wooden, metal, or Stone surface or wall within range and temporarily make the surface transparent as glass for the duration. The surface wall or floor cannot be thicker than 12 inches of solid material, otherwise the spell fails. While viewing through the transparent surface you can make it so that the receiving end cannot or can view you from the other side of the glass and create what is essentially a magical one way window.

You project forth a phantasmal image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube. The image appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration. The image is purely visual; it isn’t accompanied by sound, smell, or other sensory effects.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image.

This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8, the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring unconscious creatures).

Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this spell falls unconscious until the spell ends, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake. Subtract each creature’s hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature’s hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected. Undead and creatures immune to being charmed aren’t affected by this spell.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

You sing a Single Sonorous note and imbue the note with arcane magic that can send a target into a deep but brief slumber. Choose a Single target within range that can hear you. The target must roll a Intelligence Saving throw or fall unconscious for the next 1d4 turns. If the Target succeeds the Intelligence saving throw, they become immune to this spell and its effects for the next 24 hours.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 10 feet of each other when you target them.

You create vines of constricting bramble beneath the feet of an unexpecting enemy, in an attempt to thwart them from moving. Choose a single target within the spells range, the target must roll a Dexterity Saving throw, On a failure the target takes 1d4 piercing damage and is Restrained until the start of your next turn. If fire damage is dealt to the target while restrained by the vines, the target is freed and is no longer restrained.

A creature you touch becomes invisible until the end of the duration. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target’s person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

At Higher Levels: You are able to cast this spell with Any Spell slot of 1st level or higher, no other benefits are gained from a higher-level cast.

You conjure a Tentacle made of water either from your hand or nearby to your target that whips them and tears into their skin. Make a Spell attack towards a single target within range, On a hit, your target takes 1d6 slashing damage.
